items.title: Coca-Cola Looks To Sell Costa Coffee, Semafor Reports
items.summary: Coca-Cola is seeking to unwind its $5 billion (€4.5 billion) acquisition of British coffeehouse Costa Coffee, Semafor reported.

items.title: HMV closes London’s Oxford Street iconic flagship store (again)
items.summary: The British record store HMV is closing its iconic flagship store on Oxford Street in London, barely three years after it reopened. The main reason for the closure: the building’s owner wants to double the rent. There are also looming major renovation costs that would make the…

items.title: Beverage bottler Refresco wants to return to the stock market
items.summary: Dutch beverage producer Refresco is exploring a return to the stock market in collaboration with its major shareholder, KKR. If listed, the Rotterdam-based company could be valued at more than $10 billion (€8.9 billion).

items.title: Loacker adds to hazelnut-growing assets
items.summary: Confectionery group Loacker has expanded its hazelnut production portfolio with the acquisition of the Fontana Chiusa estate in Italy. The post Loacker adds to hazelnut-growing assets appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Kaufland Debuts Online Marketplace In Spain
items.summary: German retailer Kaufland has launched its online marketplace in Spain, expanding its footprint to nine European countries.

items.title: Mathias Mentrop Takes Over As CEO Of Penny Czechia
items.summary: Discount supermarket chain Penny has appointed Mathias Mentrop as CEO of its Czech operations, effective immediately.

items.title: Kingfisher hires new CEO from OBI
items.summary: Kingfisher has found a successor for Thierry Garnier, who is leaving to join Ahold Delhaize. The group behind B&Q and Screwfix in the United Kingdom and Castorama and Brico Depot in France is bringing in OBI CEO Sebastian Gundel as its new top executive.

items.title: “We’ve reset the business in a more profitable, more focused place” – Amy’s Kitchen CEO Paul Schiefer talks strategy and evolving US market
items.summary: Amy's CEO Paul Schiefer talks with Just Food about strategy, the US push behind non-ultra-processed foods, new technology, and GLP-1s. The post “We’ve reset the business in a more profitable, more focused place” – Amy’s Kitchen CEO Paul Schiefer talks strategy and evolving US…

items.title: Carlsberg ‘ordered to shut brewery in India over emissions’
items.summary: Carlsberg has been ordered by environmental authorities to close its brewery in the Indian state of Rajasthan over emissions breaches.

items.title: Singaporean company rescues Dutch bicycle brands Batavus, Babboe, and Koga
items.summary: Singapore-based Dutech Holdings, which also owns the Dutch bicycle components manufacturer Enviolo, is definitively acquiring the Dutch operations of the bankrupt bicycle group Accell. The deal includes the iconic brands Batavus, Babboe, and Koga, Accell’s IT platform, and its…

items.title: PepsiCo puts ‘all the urgency’ into turning around soft drinks
items.summary: The beverage giant is planning to add more functional benefits to Poppi, its newly acquired better-for-you soda brand.

items.title: Carrefour To Sell Some Real Estate Portfolio In France And Spain
items.summary: Carrefour has announced the sale of real estate portfolio comprising 35 stores in France and Spain to a joint venture.

items.title: EasyShop launches in 21 European countries: “Amazon’s challenger”
items.summary: Stelios Haji-Ioannou, the founder of easyJet, is launching easyShop.com, a new marketplace designed to compete with Amazon. As of now, the challenger is officially active in 21 European countries.

items.title: Norah to open first Belgian store in Diest; Hasselt to follow
items.summary: It won’t be in Hasselt, as previously announced, but in Diest that the Dutch women’s fashion chain Norah will open its first Belgian store later this year. “Sometimes things move faster than you’d imagined,” says CEO Han Sterk.

items.title: Refrigerators go haywire in French supermarkets due to cyberattack
items.summary: While operations at Ahold Delhaize have come to a standstill due to a security crisis, in France, the cooling systems at grocery stores are suddenly blowing out hot air on a massive scale. Hackers have breached the (outdated) software of a refrigerator supplier.

items.title: Mars invests 85 million euros in German factories
items.summary: FMCG giant Mars is allocating approximately 85 million euros for its operations in Germany by the end of 2027. The company aims to improve production processes, boost its competitiveness, and focus on technological innovation. Between 2021 and 2025, the company had already…

items.title: September UK Retail Sales Remain Slow, Shoppers Look For Budget Boost – BRC
items.summary: Retail sales growth remained slow in the UK in September 2026, as shoppers looked for a budget boost, according to BRC and KPMG.

items.title: Pernod eyes higher-abv RTD demand in UK, US with Malibu push
items.summary: Pernod Ricard is launching higher-abv RTDs under its Malibu brand in the UK and North America.

items.title: Accelerating industrial decarbonisation in France
items.summary: In France, a low-carbon grid, flexible energy markets, and growing access to financing options provide industrial companies with a strong foundation for decarbonisation. The post Accelerating industrial decarbonisation in France appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: 13,000 signatures against eliminating Dutch employee discounts
items.summary: The Dutch government wants to eliminate the employee discount, but is facing opposition: a petition against the elimination has gathered nearly 13,000 signatures. A coalition of 25 industry and sector organizations is warning of the impact on employers and employees, including…

items.title: Rosemount returns to founding family as TWE continues disposals
items.summary: Treasury Wine Estates is offloading the Rosemount wine label back to its founding family in its ongoing push to focus on fewer brands.

items.title: Constellation returns to M&A fray amid stagnant US beer market
items.summary: The move for SpikedAde is perhaps Constellation Brands’ most notable piece of M&A for around a decade.

items.title: German states criticise sugar tax plans
items.summary: A group of German ministers have hit out at the federal government to plans to implement a tax on sugary drinks.

items.title: McCain snaps up India’s Falcon Agrifriz Foods
items.summary: McCain Foods has agreed to acquire the frozen potato processing business of India-based Falcon Agrifriz Foods. The post McCain snaps up India’s Falcon Agrifriz Foods appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Fast-growing Clio yogurt bars snapped up by private equity firm
items.summary: The 11-year-old brand has been a major beneficiary of consumer demand for portability, snacking and better-for-you offerings.

items.title: Cyberattack hits French supermarkets
items.summary: Several French supermarkets have been hit by a cyberattack which has affected their refrigeration systems. The post Cyberattack hits French supermarkets appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Colruyt Group will soon offer self-checkout in 200 stores
items.summary: Colruyt Group is accelerating the rollout of self-checkout registers. Currently, 150 Okay (City), Spar, and Bio-Planet stores are equipped with self-checkout. Another 51 stores will be added later this year.

items.title: B&G Foods calls off Green Giant sale in Canada after antitrust concerns
items.summary: A regulator previously said the sale to Nortera Foods could result in higher prices, fewer choices and reduced competition.

items.title: French Supermarkets Hit By Fires And Food Losses After Cyberattack
items.summary: Cyberattacks at French supermarkets caused fire and food losses as they remotely raised fridge temperatures for hours overnight.

items.title: IDDBA Welcomes Suzanne Fanning As New Chair Of Board
items.summary: IDDBA and Dairy Farmers of Wisconsin (DFW) have announced Suzanne Fanning as Chair of IDDBA’s Board of Directors.

items.title: Waitrose Rolls Out Gammon Joint And Lardons Made Without Nitrites
items.summary: Waitrose & Partners has expanded its ‘Made Without Nitrites’ range with gammon joint and smoked bacon lardons.

items.title: LVMH continues to struggle due to weakness in China
items.summary: French luxury giant LVMH, the parent company of Louis Vuitton and Dior, also reported disappointing sales growth in the third quarter, due to weak demand from China. Is this a sign of a further slowdown in the luxury sector, which has been facing headwinds for three years now?

items.title: Kerry Group Opens Coffee Extraction Facility
items.summary: Kerry Group has opened a coffee extraction facility in Pennsylvania, its first manufacturing site in the US state.

items.title: Ahold Delhaize IT outage: empty shelves at Albert Heijn, limited e-commerce at Delhaize
items.summary: The effects of the cyber incident at Ahold Delhaize are still being felt on Tuesday. At Albert Heijn, the online store is down and there is a risk of empty shelves; at Delhaize, stores are receiving deliveries, but e-commerce is operating on a limited basis.

items.title: H&M is also investigating a possible hack, but hasn’t found anything (yet)
items.summary: As if the cyber incidents at Ahold Delhaize and the refrigeration systems at French supermarkets this week weren’t enough, the H&M Group is now also investigating reports of a possible hack. However, it remains unclear whether a breach actually occurred: the fashion giant has…

items.title: Irish Consumers Increasingly Opt For Contactless
items.summary: The number of Irish consumers choosing contactless payment continues to grow, according to research conducted for a global fintech company.

items.title: UK Grocery Inflation Accelerates Over Last Month, Says Worldpanel
items.summary: British grocery price inflation accelerated to 2.5% over the four weeks to 4 October, market researcher Worldpanel by Numerator said.

items.title: Buyer emerges for four Gamma stores in Wallonia, but not for the staff
items.summary: Four of the six Gamma stores in Wallonia that are at risk of closing are said to have found a buyer. For the 74 employees, however, this potential deal offers no certainty for the time being: the prospective buyer reportedly does not intend to retain the staff.

items.title: Greencore Continues To Grow In Q4, Raises FY26 Profit Guidance
items.summary: Greencore has raised its full-year operating profit guidance after reporting continued growth and strong performance in the fourth quarter.

items.title: Greencore lifts profit forecast again
items.summary: Convenience-food maker Greencore has raised its profit guidance again, citing volume growth it said was ahead of the broader sector. The post Greencore lifts profit forecast again appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Givaudan Sales Beat Market View On Fine Fragrance Strength, Boosting Shares
items.summary: Demand for luxury perfumes and continued recovery in flavours drove Givaudan’s organic sales growth beyond market expectations.
